product_statement: NetCoin is a wallet-first public testnet cryptocurrency ecosystem: manage NET, understand the chain, participate in markets/community, operate infrastructure, and build on the protocol.
north_star: A first-time user should understand Core -> Network -> Build -> Ecosystem, with Explorer/Download/Home/Markets/Wallet in Core, in under 30 seconds.

jobs.label: Manage money
jobs.description: Create a wallet, receive NET, send NET, label activity, back up and recover safely.

jobs.label: Understand the blockchain
jobs.description: Search addresses, transactions, blocks, mempool state, network status and finality.

jobs.label: Participate
jobs.description: Use testnet faucet, markets, community discussions, bounties, ideas, governance and treasury.

jobs.label: Operate infrastructure
jobs.description: Run nodes, monitor health, operate exchange/custody, diagnose incidents and verify releases.

jobs.label: Build
jobs.description: Use docs, APIs, SDKs, architecture, examples and migration/parity status to build on NetCoin.

user.label: User
user.goal: Manage NET and verify activity with minimal complexity.

trader.label: Trader
trader.goal: Trade prediction markets while keeping wallet and portfolio context visible.

operator.label: Operator
operator.goal: Monitor nodes, health, releases, exchange/custody and incident response.

developer.label: Developer
developer.goal: Build integrations and inspect architecture, OpenAPI, SDKs and parity/migration status.

product_rules: Every page has exactly one visually dominant primary action.
Advanced controls are hidden until they are relevant.
Never create a new page when a panel or drawer is enough.
Never create a new component when an existing product component can be reused.
Every error explains what happened, why it matters, and what to do next.
Every irreversible workflow has review, confirmation, result, and recovery states.
Every feature must improve an existing workflow, remove a hard ceiling, increase trust/safety/clarity, or reduce complexity.
phase0_acceptance_criteria: Primary top navigation is limited to Wallet, Explorer, and Markets plus grouped Ecosystem.
Every public surface is assigned to one of the five user jobs.
The design system defines one page template, card taxonomy, button taxonomy, status vocabulary, spacing scale and typography scale.
The homepage explains Wallet, Explorer, Markets, Network, Community and Developers without listing every capability.
A checker exists to prevent future navigation and information-architecture sprawl.
Canonical design-system tokens and workflow architecture are validated by tools/check_design_system.py.
Every canonical workflow has a primary action, trust signals, and advanced controls hidden until needed.
